ImageDescription.value: : Basilica former Immaculata Conception parish. The foundations of the 11th century rotunda where Elisabeth probably christined can be see front of the Basilica. This small (7 meter diameter) royal chapel was dedicated to Saint Nicholas, it was remodelled to a circular church/chapel and had a horseshoe scancntuaray and east facing altar. In the 13th century the Sárospatak Castle was founded and the Rotunda became the parish church. After the basilica completed (without the west tower) around the 16th century the Rotunda became the churchyard cemetery chapel. - Szent Erzsébet Street, Old Town, Sárospatak, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County, Hungary.

ImageDescription.value: : Basilica former Immaculata Conception parish. South side. The foundations of the 11th century rotunda where Elisabeth probably christined can be see front of the Basilica. This small (7 meter diameter) royal chapel was dedicated to Saint Nicholas, it was remodelled to a circular church/chapel and had a horseshoe scancntuaray and east facing altar. In the 13th century the Sárospatak Castle was founded and the Rotunda became the parish church. After the basilica completed (without the west tower) around the 16th century the Rotunda became the churchyard cemetery chapel. In 2014 the pavement and the Rotunda renewed with limestone elements from Süttő and Tardos architect Mihály Rudolf - Szent Erzsébet Street, Old Town, Sárospatak, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County, Hungary.
